The Good Daughter Is One Exhausting Trauma Dump After Another

The Good Daughter opens with the kind of formative act of violence that thrillers typically save for climactic flashbacks. Two masked gunmen looking to exact revenge on a small-town Georgia defense lawyer invade his home to find only his wife and two daughters. This nightmare continues that day and reverberates through the girls’ adult lives.
